title: Coffee Sangria
ldInstructionsRaw: Start by brewing about a gallon of cold-brew coffee. Combine the coffee and water in the Toddy (or whichever brew method suits you) and let sit for 10-12 hours. Strain the coffee through the filter and decant into a jug. Set aside.

When the coffee is strained and ready, zest the orange into the batch, then add all the fruit into the finished coffee and give it a stir. Let it sit for about 4-6 hours, then strain the coffee and discard the fruit. Taste, then add simple syrup to taste.
